root_cause_hypothesis: The case OUTCOME is met - full build 0 errors, 0 BP errors, and every dual-write marker survives deserialization (EntityCategory=Master, IsPublic=Yes, PublicEntityName=ConDemoSyncCustomer, PublicCollectionName=ConDemoSyncCustomers, PrimaryKey=EntityKey -> AxDataEntityViewKey[EntityKey] over CustomerCode i.e. NOT RecId, plus AllowRowVersionChangeTracking=Yes on both objects). But it is met only because the agent HAND-AUTHORED the parts no tool can express, so the run is a TOOL_DEFECT, not a PASS, and the golden stays DRAFT. PRIMARY DEFECT - the case central requirement is unreachable through any tool path. Change tracking on an AxDataEntityView is the metamodel property AllowRowVersionChangeTracking (reflection over Microsoft.Dynamics.AX.Metadata.dll, MetaModel.AxDataEntityView, lists AllowRowVersionChangeTracking:NoYes and NO ChangeTrackingEnabled; 1484 shipped entities set it Yes, none set No; the 22 shipped files still carrying the legacy ChangeTrackingEnabled element are silently dropped by the deserializer). It was passed in properties to d365fo_file(action=create, objectType=data-entity) and SILENTLY DISCARDED - no warning, unlike add-index which at least reports IGNORED parameters. There is then no repair route: EVERY modify operation on objectType=data-entity is rejected by the bridge - modify-property, add-field-group AND add-method were each tested and each returned "Operation X on object type data-entity is not supported by the bridge". This is broader than the add-field-group-only gap recorded for the sibling case L2-virtual-entity-power-platform. SECOND DEFECT - the same property on the TABLE side is blocked by a hardcoded allowlist. d365fo_file(action=modify, operation=modify-property, propertyPath=AllowRowVersionChangeTracking) on AxTable fails with "Unknown AxTable property ... Supported: label, developerDocumentation, configurationKey, formRef, tableGroup, cacheLookup, clusteredIndex, primaryIndex, replacementKey, saveDataPerCompany, tableType, supportInheritance, instanceRelationType, extends, titleField1, titleField2" - 16 names, while the metamodel AxTable exposes AllowRowVersionChangeTracking:NoYes. Inconsistently, ModifiedDateTime - also absent from that allowlist - SUCCEEDED minutes earlier via a "direct XML fallback (the element did not exist; inserted in canonical AxTable element order)". So the same operation has two code paths and the fallback does not catch every unknown property. THIRD DEFECT (repeat of the sibling case) - the AxDataEntityView create writer omits SourceCode, FieldGroups, DeleteActions and StateMachines. Census this run over all 5900 shipped AxDataEntityView files in PackagesLocalDirectory: SourceCode 5900/5900, FieldGroups 5899/5900, DeleteActions 5899/5900, StateMachines 5899/5900, DynamicFields 5894/5900. action=generate produces byte-identical output to action=create, confirming one shared template writer rather than IMetadataProvider. generate additionally drops the model prefix (emits DemoSyncCustomerEntity, not ConDemoSyncCustomerEntity) and hardcodes the key name to EntityKey, silently ignoring a supplied primaryKey. KNOWLEDGE GAP - get_knowledge(topic=dual-write), which the instruction explicitly tells the agent to ground on, never mentions AllowRowVersionChangeTracking. It advises "For custom entities: add DataManagementEnabled=Yes, IsPublic=Yes, PublicEntityName/CollectionName". An agent following the KB alone cannot satisfy "change tracking enabled on the entity so incremental sync works". Worse, the KB omits the CROSS-OBJECT rule that makes this a tier-3 case: enabling the property on the entity alone FAILS the build with "Metadata Error: AxDataEntityView/ConDemoSyncCustomerEntity/DataSources/ConDemoSyncCustomer/AllowRowVersionChangeTracking: Change tracking cannot be enabled since the Allow Row Version Change Tracking property is not set to Yes for the table". The table must carry it too. VALIDATOR GAP - validate_code(mode=references, codeType=xml-any) on an AxDataEntityView resolves ONLY Label. A deliberate probe with DataSource=ZZZNoSuchTableAtAll, DataField=ZZZNoSuchField and PrimaryKey=NoSuchKey returned exactly one finding - the bad label - and zero errors. The clean "all 1 reference(s) verified" on the real entity XML was therefore the label and nothing else. This independently reproduces the note in the sibling record. BP MEASUREMENT DEFECT - the FIRST run_bp_check against the data entity, targetElementType=dataentityview, printed "BP Check passed" with NO "N elements processed." line, hiding a real BP ERROR. An identical re-run of the same call printed "1 elements processed." and surfaced "DataEntitySecurityPrivilegeCheck: The data entity is not assigned to a security privilege". Separately, targetElementType=dataentity (invalid) ALSO printed "BP Check passed" while the body said "The element type dataentity is invalid". The reliable tell in both shapes is the absence of the "N elements processed." line; the green banner is not trustworthy on its own. MINOR - failed modify calls still drop .backup-<timestamp> files into the AOT folder: both rejected data-entity modify attempts created ConDemoSyncCustomerEntity.xml.backup-* even though the bridge wrote nothing. bp_clean scored 0 on 3 warnings that are all case-scope artifacts (no form, no duty, and DeveloperDocumentation would need a fresh label); the case own gate is zero BP ERRORS, which is met exactly.
suggested_fix_area: 1) The shared AxDataEntityView XML builder behind d365fo_file(action=create|generate): (a) honour AllowRowVersionChangeTracking (and the other NoYes metamodel properties) instead of dropping unrecognised properties silently - at minimum echo an IGNORED-parameter warning the way add-index does; (b) emit SourceCode/Declaration (public class <Name> extends common), the five standard FieldGroups incl. AutoIdentification with AutoPopulate=Yes, and empty DeleteActions and StateMachines in MS element order (Name, SourceCode, Label, AllowRowVersionChangeTracking, DataManagementEnabled, DataManagementStagingTable, EntityCategory, IsPublic, PrimaryKey, PublicCollectionName, PublicEntityName, DeleteActions, FieldGroups, Fields, Keys, Mappings, Ranges, Relations, StateMachines, ViewMetadata - verified against ApplicationSuite/Foundation/AxDataEntityView/AssetConditionEntity.xml); (c) stop hardcoding the key name to EntityKey when primaryKey is supplied; (d) apply EXTENSION_PREFIX in action=generate as it is in action=create. 2) Bridge modify dispatcher: objectType=data-entity currently supports NO operation at all. Add at least modify-property (and add-field-group / add-method), or route data-entity modify through the same direct-XML fallback the AxTable path already has. 3) AxTable modify-property: replace the 16-name allowlist with the metamodel property set (reflect AxTable NoYes/String properties), or always fall through to the canonical-order direct-XML writer - the inconsistency where ModifiedDateTime succeeds and AllowRowVersionChangeTracking hard-fails is the bug. 4) get_knowledge(topic=dual-write): add AllowRowVersionChangeTracking as THE AOT change-tracking property for entities, plus the cross-object rule that the source table must set it too, plus the note that ChangeTrackingEnabled is legacy and silently dropped. Also record that EntityCategory=Master is the enum default and therefore absent from all 5900 shipped files. 5) validate_code(mode=references, codeType=xml-any): walk AxDataEntityView DataSource/Table/DataField/PrimaryKey/Keys refs, not just Label. Currently near-zero coverage on this artifact type. 6) run_bp_check: never print the BP-Check-passed banner unless the xppbp output contains an "N elements processed." line with N greater than 0; surface an explicit BP-NOT-MEASURED result otherwise, and treat an element-type-is-invalid body as a hard error rather than a pass. 7) d365fo_file(action=modify): do not write .backup-timestamp files when the operation is rejected before any write.
